content:
{'translation': '備受矚目的電視艾美獎將於本週末揭開序幕，首輪公布創意藝術獎得獎名單。黃金時段頒獎典禮將於9月14日舉行，屆時將頒發最佳劇情類劇集及最佳喜劇類劇集等最高殊榮。', 'source_text': 'The Emmys are getting underway this weekend, with the first batch of Creative Arts winners set to be announced. The primetime ceremony takes place on September 14, where the top prizes like Best Drama Series and Best Comedy Series will be handed out.'}

{'translation': '截至目前，Apple應該對其取得的成績感到非常滿意，其旗下Apple TV+本週末以破紀錄的20項大獎領先群雄。大部分殊榮來自人氣喜劇《Widows Bay》，該劇勇奪8獎，現已成為喜劇類別每項大獎的頂頭大熱。', 'source_text': 'At the moment, Apple should be feeling pretty good about itself, with Apple TV+ leading the way with a record-breaking 20 wins this weekend. The majority come from the hit comedy Widows Bay, which scooped up eight awards and is now the frontrunner for every comedy category.'}

{'translation': '2026年艾美獎目前的累計獎項數，Apple以20獎居首，HBO Max以16獎緊隨其後，Netflix則以13獎位列第三。預期黃金時段艾美獎全數公布後，後兩家串流平台將超越Apple，但Apple仍穩居一個令人尊敬的第三位。', 'source_text': 'In the current 2026 Emmys tally, Apple sits at the top with 20 wins, HBO Max is second with 16, and Netflix is third with 13. After the primetime Emmys are handed out, both streaming services are expected to overtake Apple, leaving it in a respectable third.'}

{'translation': 'Apple預期將主導喜劇類別，但可能在劇情類別中不敵《The Pitt》等劇集。答案將於下週一揭曉。', 'source_text': 'Apple is expected to dominate the comedy categories, but could be beaten in the drama categories by the likes of The Pitt. Answers arrive Monday.'}

{'translation': "至今為止，《Widows Bay》奪得8獎、《Pluribus》獲得4獎、《Margo's Got Money Troubles》取得3獎、《Palm Royale》同樣贏得3獎，紀錄片《Mr Scorsese》則拿下1獎。", 'source_text': "So far, Widows Bay took home eight, Pluribus four, Margo's Got Money Troubles three, Palm Royale three, and the documentary Mr Scorsese won one."}

{'translation': "以上Apple TV劇集共奪得19獎；Apple另憑其廣告「I'm Not Remarkable」贏得1獎，合計達到標題所述的20獎：", 'source_text': "That totals 19 wins for Apple TV shows, with Apple taking home another for its ad I'm Not Remarkable, bringing the total to the 20 wins mentioned in the headline:"}

{'translation': '《Widow’s Bay》', 'source_text': 'Widow’s Bay'}

  • {'translation': '最佳喜劇類劇集客串女演員：Betty Gilpin', 'source_text': 'Best Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin'}
  • {'translation': '最佳半小時節目製作設計', 'source_text': 'Best Production Design For a Half-Hour Program'}
  • {'translation': '最佳喜劇類劇集選角', 'source_text': 'Best Casting for a Comedy Series'}
  • {'translation': '最佳半小時劇集攝影', 'source_text': 'Best Cinematography For a Half-Hour Series'}
  • {'translation': '最佳劇集原創劇情配樂', 'source_text': 'Best Original Dramatic Score for a Series'}
  • {'translation': '最佳音樂監督', 'source_text': 'Best Music Supervision'}
  • {'translation': '最佳半小時喜劇或劇情類劇集及動畫音效剪輯', 'source_text': 'Best Sound Editing For a Half-Hour Comedy or Drama Series or Animation'}
  • {'translation': '最佳半小時喜劇或劇情類劇集及動畫混音', 'source_text': 'Best Sound Mixing For a Half-Hour Comedy or Drama Series or Animation'}

{'translation': '《Pluribus》', 'source_text': 'Pluribus'}

  • {'translation': '最佳一小時或以上當代節目製作設計', 'source_text': 'Best Production Design For a Contemporary Program of One Hour or More'}
  • {'translation': '最佳劇情類劇集剪輯', 'source_text': 'Best Drama Series Editing'}
  • {'translation': '最佳原創片頭主題音樂', 'source_text': 'Best Original Main Title Theme Music'}
  • {'translation': '最佳一小時喜劇或劇情類劇集混音', 'source_text': 'Best Sound Mixing For a One-Hour Comedy or Drama Series'}

{'translation': "《Margo's Got Money Troubles》", 'source_text': "Margo's Got Money Troubles"}

  • {'translation': '最佳劇集當代服裝設計', 'source_text': 'Best Contemporary Costume Design For a Series'}
  • {'translation': '最佳當代髮型設計', 'source_text': 'Best Contemporary Hairstyling'}
  • {'translation': '最佳當代化妝（非特技造型）', 'source_text': 'Best Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)'}

{'translation': '《Palm Royale》', 'source_text': 'Palm Royale'}

  • {'translation': '最佳劇本節目編舞', 'source_text': 'Best Choreography For a Scripted Program'}
  • {'translation': '最佳劇集時代劇服裝設計', 'source_text': 'Best Period Costume Design For a Series'}
  • {'translation': '最佳時代劇或奇幻／科幻化妝（非特技造型）', 'source_text': 'Best Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)'}

{'translation': '《Mr. Scorsese》', 'source_text': 'Mr. Scorsese'}

  • {'translation': '最佳紀錄片或非小說類劇集', 'source_text': 'Best Documentary or Nonfiction Series'}

{'translation': 'Apple TV本季以破紀錄的89項艾美獎提名入圍，至於最終能在9月14日黃金時段艾美獎頒獎典禮上將多少提名轉化為獎座，仍有待觀察。這一切再次彰顯業界評論家對Apple整體節目陣容的高度讚譽。', 'source_text': "With 89 nominations this season – a record for Apple TV – it's yet to be seen how many of those will be converted into wins at the primetime Emmy ceremony on September 14. It once again highlights the critical acclaim for Apple's overall lineup."}
